Use case: stylized-concept. Create an accurate editorial information-illustration background for a real open-source C# GPU application. Premium futuristic cartoon 3D look matching white ceramic robot assistants with expressive black faceplates, midnight navy laboratory, coral HIP accents, cyan MIGraphX accents, violet rim lighting. Critical redesign: information first, mascot second. One small robot occupies at most 10 percent of the composition, at the top right only. NO spacecraft, planets, floating abstract AI brain or unrelated science-fiction props. The software workflow must be obvious from concrete input, computing, human review and output objects. Landscape canvas 1536x1024. RENDER NO TEXT, LETTERS, NUMBERS, LOGOS OR WATERMARKS: all accurate Chinese labels will be professionally overlaid after generation. Strict layout: keep the entire top strip y=0..220 clean dark navy for the title. Four evenly spaced translucent vertical rounded illustration cards in a single horizontal row: card 1 x=48..390, card 2 x=414..756, card 3 x=780..1122, card 4 x=1146..1488. Cards extend y=235..910. On each card leave y=250..360 and y=760..905 dark and empty for text overlays. Place each concrete large illustration entirely inside its card at y=380..735. Thin left-to-right cyan arrows between the four cards at y=550 indicate progression. No decorative lines crossing the label-safe regions. Each stage is distinct and recognizable when scaled down. Do not simulate a screenshot of a delivered application. The result is a clear four-step illustrated infographic, not a mascot poster or a dense block diagram. Maintain strong silhouettes and deep dark flat label zones.

Instead of the four-card template, create ONLY an unobtrusive dark futuristic-laboratory BACKGROUND for a software architecture diagram that will be drawn later. Keep x=20..1300 almost entirely empty, uniformly very dark navy. A small friendly white cartoon robot holds a glowing pointer at the far right x=1360..1510,y=600..880, never entering the central region. Extremely subtle coral/cyan circuits near the outermost edges only. No platforms, rectangles, nodes, arrows, layers or text in the central canvas. The large blank dark center will contain precise layered software API blocks. Do not fill it with imagery.
